exercises.q: The dog came running to us.
exercises.why: **прибежала** — прибежа́ть (perfective): to come running. Wiktionary: при- + бежа́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to run away, to make off, to flee
to run up, to come running up to
to come running in, to come rushing in, to run (into)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: убега́ть — to run away, to make off, to flee; прибежа́ть — to come running; подбежа́ть — to run up, to come running up to; вбежа́ть — to come running in, to come rushing in, to run (into).
**вбежал** — вбежа́ть (perfective): to come running in, to come rushing in, to run (into). Wiktionary: в- + бежа́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **вбежал** — вбежа́ть (perfective): to come running in, to come rushing in, to run (into). Wiktionary: в- + бежа́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **сбежите** — сбежа́ть (perfective): to run down (from); to run away, to make off, to flee, to break out; to escape; to elope. Wiktionary: с- + бежа́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **сбежал** — сбежа́ть (perfective): to run down (from); to run away, to make off, to flee, to break out; to escape; to elope. Wiktionary: с- + бежа́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Fadil resorted to a desperate measure.
exercises.why: **прибегнул** — прибе́гнуть (perfective): to resort, to have recourse, to fall back (upon). Wiktionary: при- + бегнуть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: We'll have to fall back on our reserves.
exercises.why: **прибегнуть** — прибе́гнуть (perfective): to resort, to have recourse, to fall back (upon). Wiktionary: при- + бегнуть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **избежал** — избежа́ть (perfective): to avoid, to refrain from; to keep off, to steer clear of, to shun, to evade, to elude; to escape. Wiktionary: из- + бежа́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to resort, to have recourse, to fall back (upon)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: забе́гать — to start running; сбежа́ть — to run down (from); прибе́гнуть — to resort, to have recourse, to fall back (upon); избежа́ть — to avoid, to refrain from.
